premises.text: Average users cannot see, secure, or control the personal data platforms harvest and monetize
premises.evidence_span: the average user has no idea what data they're generating or who can see it, let alone how to actually secure their data

premises.text: Users sync platforms into anonymized encrypted categories; only the user holds the private key, and approved companies pay a reverse subscription into the user's payout account
premises.evidence_span: Ozone offers a reverse subscription model where companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data

premises.text: Encrypted machine learning matches only user-approved data to targeted offers and returns pre-approved audiences for advertisers who pay for conversions
premises.evidence_span: Ozone then runs encrypted machine learning to match only the data you want to share with offers that are targeted for you

premises.text: Freemium: consumers get free organize/secure tools; companies pay for pre-approved audiences and conversions, not just eyeballs
premises.evidence_span: consumers get simple, free tools to organize and secure their personal data, and companies get pre-approved audiences and only pay for conversions, not just eyeballs like on Facebook

value.text: Users take back control of their data and share in the value platforms earn from it via ethically sourced, user-controlled data
value.evidence_span: Take back control of your data, and take back the billions that big data is earning on you

causal_links.evidence_span: Data control should be a fundamental human right with equal data rights for all
This is ethically sourced data that's controlled by the user
companies get pre-approved audiences and only pay for conversions, not just eyeballs like on Facebook

notes: Sync/organize/encrypt and reverse subscription kept as one user-side control mechanism; encrypted ML matching split as distinct advertiser-matching mechanism (tie-break). Patents folded into mechanism IP detail (v1.3.1). Lifetime-earnings/401k demo treated as product facet, not extra premise.
